opus.problem: The age of eighty-five comes from Joshua 14:10, not the cited Joshua 14:11, which gives only the strength statement. The clue is not fully true to its cited verse.
'Of the tribe of Judah' is not in Joshua 14:13, which says only 'Caleb son of Jephunneh'. The tribe detail comes from elsewhere (Numbers 13:6), so the clue is not fully true to its cited verse.

The clue makes two points: the Acsah marriage offer and the springs she received. The springs (Joshua 15:19) are not in the cited Joshua 15:16, which breaks 'one point each' and makes the clue not true to its cited verse.
